_metadata.selection: Only the four Julia microbenchmarks: Go, C2MIR, and paired C2MIR process timings.
_metadata.methodology: Twenty alternating original/tuned A/B pairs per port, each in a fresh process with one complete untimed warmup. Only tuned comparison samples contribute to this patch. Five original/original pairs per port screen timing noise. Workload and process medians are computed separately from the same launches. Builds precede all final measurements. Workload counts, scalar arithmetic order and 391 synchronous output batches are unchanged.

metadata.timing: self-reported workload; one full warmup per process
